key_events: Merneptah Stele (c. 1208 BCE: first extra-biblical mention of 'Israel')
Saul, David (Tel Dan Stele 'House of David'), Solomon
First Temple built on Mount Moriah
Northern Kingdom of Israel (Samaria) fell 722 BCE to Sargon II of Assyria; 10 tribes dispersed
Southern Kingdom of Judah (Jerusalem) survived Sennacherib's siege 701 BCE (Siloam inscription)
Cyrus the Great decreed return 538 BCE
Second Temple completed 516 BCE under Zerubbabel
Ezra the Scribe reinstated Torah public reading
